newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli-backed militia official killed by bomb.
newsitem.headline: Israeli-backed militia official killed by bomb.

text.p: A security official of the Israeli-backed South Lebanon Army militia was killed on Saturday when a bomb exploded near his house, militia sources said.
The SLA sources said Kameel Nimr was killed when the bomb went off near his home in the village of Aishiyeh on the edge of Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone.
No further details were immediately available and it was not known who was behind the blast.
Pro-Iranian Hizbollah (Party of God) guerrillas have in the past killed a number of SLA officials in similar bomb attacks in the border zone in the past.

Hizbollah leads an Islamic Resistance to oust some 1,000 Israeli troops and the 3,000-strong SLA from the 15-km (nine-mile) -deep zone in south Lebanon set up by the Jewish state to stop cross-border raids on northern Israel.
